name: motion-ui-videos-promo
description: The motion-ui-videos skill's own promo, made from the skill's template: a 9:16 reel, a 16:9 showcase and their stills, with the template's Lumen demo playing live inside them.

scripts.render:showcase: node sound/design.mjs showcase && remotion render src/index.ts showcase out/showcase.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --audio-bitrate 320k
scripts.render:reel: node sound/design.mjs reel && remotion render src/index.ts reel out/reel.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --audio-bitrate 256k
scripts.render:loop: remotion render src/index.ts loop out/loop.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --muted
scripts.render:story: node sound/design.mjs story && remotion render src/index.ts story out/story.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:promo-reel: node sound/design.mjs promo-reel && remotion render src/index.ts promo-reel out/promo-reel.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --audio-bitrate 256k
scripts.render:promo-showcase: node sound/design.mjs promo-showcase && remotion render src/index.ts promo-showcase out/promo-showcase.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --audio-bitrate 320k
